svg.title: Where the voice turn's seconds go
svg.desc: The voice turn's mean voice-to-voice time stacked by stage from the end of the caller's speech, beside 24 agent sessions but for voice alone: voice alone, 1.62 s, 0.09 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 0.22 s decoding the first sentence; tuned vLLM, 5.30 s, 2.81 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 1.07 s decoding the first sentence; preempt-resubmit, 2.08 s, 0.28 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 0.39 s decoding the first sentence; the KV preemption, 3.41 s, 0.78 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 1.21 s decoding the first sentence; the change, 2.15 s, 0.30 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 0.44 s decoding the first sentence; the configuration to deploy, 1.97 s, 0.29 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 0.26 s decoding the first sentence.
svg.text: Wait for the LLM's first token
Mean time from the end of the caller's speech (s)
